title: Agent Governance Event Format (AGEF) v1
description: Standard format for AI agent governance events. AGEF provides a structured, interoperable schema for recording policy decisions, guardrail activations, approval workflows, cost tracking, and audit evidence across any AI agent framework.

agef_version.description: AGEF specification version. Fixed to '1.0.0' for all events conforming to this schema revision.

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this event. MUST be a UUID v4 or v7.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event was created. MUST include timezone offset or use UTC (Z suffix).

event_type.description: Categorizes the governance event. Determines which optional sections are expected to be populated.

agent.description: Identity and lineage of the agent that triggered or is subject to this event.

id.description: Unique identifier for the agent instance. Opaque string assigned by the host system.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the agent.

framework.description: Name of the AI agent framework powering this agent.

model.description: Identifier of the LLM model used by this agent.

parent_agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent that delegated work to this agent. Null or absent for root agents.

chain_id.description: Shared identifier linking all agents in a single delegation chain. Enables tracing from root orchestrator to leaf worker.

chain_depth.description: Zero-based depth of this agent in the delegation chain. Root agent is 0, its direct delegate is 1, and so on.

action.description: The operation the agent intends to perform or has performed. Present on policy_decision and audit_entry events.

type.description: Category of the operation. Should use a consistent vocabulary within a deployment.

target.description: The system, resource, or endpoint the action is directed at.

params.description: Arbitrary key-value parameters of the action. Contents are domain-specific. Sensitive values SHOULD be redacted before recording.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what the action does and why.

decision.description: The governance decision rendered for an action. Present on policy_decision events.

outcome.description: The disposition of the governance evaluation. 'allowed' permits execution, 'blocked' prevents it, 'masked' permits with redacted data, 'warned' permits with advisory logged, 'escalated' defers to human approval.

risk_level.description: Assessed risk level of the action. Maps to RiskLevel enum in the Aegis reference implementation.

rule.description: Name or identifier of the policy rule that matched. Empty string if no rule matched and defaults were applied.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this decision was made.

approval_required.description: Whether the action requires explicit human approval before execution.

guardrail.description: Details of a guardrail activation. Present on guardrail_trigger events.

name.description: Identifier of the guardrail that triggered.

type.description: Category of the guardrail. Determines interpretation of the details and matches fields.

action.description: The disposition applied by this guardrail.

details.description: Human-readable summary of what was detected and what action was taken.

input_content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the original input content. Enables correlation without storing sensitive data.

masked_content.description: The content after masking transformations, when action is 'masked'. Null if no masking was applied.

matches.description: Individual findings detected by this guardrail.

value_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the matched value. Actual value MUST NOT be stored for PII matches.

location.description: Position of the match within the content.

confidence.description: Confidence score of the detection, from 0.0 (lowest) to 1.0 (highest).

approval.description: Human approval workflow data. Present on approval_request and approval_response events.

request_id.description: Unique identifier linking an approval request to its response.

responded_at.description: Timestamp when the human responded. Null on approval_request events.

approver.description: Identity of the human approver. Null on approval_request events.

decision.description: The human's decision. Null on approval_request events.

reason.description: Optional reason provided by the approver.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time (in seconds) allowed for the human to respond before auto-deny.

cost.description: Token usage and cost tracking data. Present on cost_alert events and optionally on any event involving LLM calls.

model.description: Identifier of the LLM model that generated the cost.

total_tokens.description: Total tokens consumed (input + output). Provided for convenience.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated cost in USD for this specific LLM call.

cumulative_cost_usd.description: Cumulative cost in USD for the current session or chain.

budget_remaining_usd.description: Remaining budget in USD after this cost. Null if no budget is configured.

budget_limit_usd.description: Total budget limit in USD for the agent or session. Null if no budget is configured.

budget_utilization_pct.description: Percentage of budget consumed (0-100). Null if no budget is configured.

rate_limit.description: Rate limiting details. Present on rate_limit events.

limit_type.description: The type of rate limit that was hit or is being tracked.

current_value.description: The current usage value at the time of the event.

window_seconds.description: Duration of the rate limit window in seconds.

action_taken.description: What action was taken in response to the rate limit.

retry_after_seconds.description: Recommended wait time in seconds before retrying. Null if not applicable.

evidence.description: Tamper-evidence fields that establish integrity and ordering of the event stream. Enables hash-chain verification of the audit trail.

hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical form of this event (excluding the evidence.hash field itself). Format: 'sha256:<hex>'.

previous_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the immediately preceding event in this session's chain. Null for the first event in a session. Format: 'sha256:<hex>'.

session_id.description: Identifier for the governance session. All events in one agent execution session share this ID.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing counter within a session. Starts at 0 for the first event.

signature.description: Optional cryptographic signature of the event hash. Format is implementation-defined (e.g., 'ed25519:<base64>').

context.description: Deployment and environment context for the event.

service.description: Name of the service or application hosting the agent.

deployment_id.description: Identifier for the specific deployment or release.

trace_id.description: OpenTelemetry-compatible trace ID for correlation with distributed tracing.

span_id.description: OpenTelemetry-compatible span ID for correlation with distributed tracing.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs for implementation-specific data. No schema constraints are imposed on the contents.

then.description: Policy decision events MUST include both the action that was evaluated and the decision rendered.
Guardrail trigger events MUST include the guardrail details.
Approval request events MUST include the action requiring approval and the approval workflow data.
Approval response events MUST include the approval workflow data with the human's decision.
Cost alert events MUST include the cost tracking data.
Rate limit events MUST include the rate limiting details.
